tldr: Initial treatment changes later readiness, and a shared seat pool couples the two stages. For every historical sample size and cohort size, the exact finite-cohort minimax welfare regret is zero at cohort size two and otherwise has rate min{n^{-1/2}, sqrt(m)/n + 1/sqrt(mn)}. A total original-history plug-in allocation attains the upper bound, while original-likelihood tests give the matching converse over every randomized rule. The result separates stochastic-capacity smoothing from integer-crossing regimes and proves exactly when a fluid approximation preserves the order of statistical risk.
